rationale: Contained single-module change with a named file list and a passing test to pin it, so blast radius is low and ambiguity is low. local-code-standard is free and guarantees the 64k context and tool calling the work needs, which local-code-fast does not. Subscription capacity is left for the stories that need judgement. Fallbacks are ordered by what is actually available if the local GPU is busy, not by capability.
